description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_LanguageFactory class responsible for creating and managing language objects within the HTMLPurifier library. It handles caching of language data, fallbacks, and loading language definitions from external files.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_LanguageFactory
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for creating, caching, and managing HTMLPurifier_Language objects, including handling fallbacks and language data loading from external files.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of the factory, optionally resetting or overloading with a prototype.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the singleton, setting up the language validator and directory path.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a language object for the specified configuration and context, handling class fallback if necessary.

methods.name: getFallbackFor
methods.description: Returns the fallback language code for a given language.

methods.name: loadLanguage
methods.description: Loads language data into cache from external message files, handling fallbacks and merging.
